impact: Premarket chip euphoria is fading in a thin holiday session; MU and DRAM keep a smaller gain, and NVDA's reversal is a caution flag for NBIS and the AI complex into month-end.
summary: US stocks opened higher (S&P 500 up about 1-1.2%, Nasdaq Composite up 1.5-1.6%, Dow up about 507 points) but gains narrowed to roughly +0.6-0.7% for the S&P and +0.7-0.8% for the Nasdaq. Nvidia opened green then fell about 2%, while Micron held up about 2% after a 6%+ premarket jump. The S&P is up about 5.1% and the Nasdaq 5.8% on the week; markets close at 1 p.m. ET. Analysts flagged China tariff threats and $92 Brent as risks.
title: Black Friday rally narrows after open: Nasdaq up about 0.7-0.8%, Nvidia turns down 2%
